# Reader fonts

MiSans Regular and Bold are unmodified WOFF2 files from Xiaomi's
[official distribution](https://hyperos.mi.com/font/zh/download/).
They are included as part of this application and its generated readers, with
visible attribution and the complete license. They are not offered as a separate
font download product. No glyph subsetting or font conversion is performed.

JetBrains Mono Regular, Italic, Bold and Bold Italic are the unmodified WOFF2
files from [version 2.304](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/tree/v2.304),
licensed under SIL OFL 1.1.

`provenance.json` records upstream URLs, the pinned JetBrains commit, the MiSans
archive digest, file sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The reader template registry pins
the font and license bytes. Generated pages show attribution and both licenses;
resource bundles also retain the license text files. Published font requests stay
on the application origin, and offline exports inline font bytes as data URLs.
